manual.siren.line2: When things go wrong in a factory, the workers must be notified with a loud warning signal, audible over the noise of the heavy machinery.{0}
manual.siren.line3: The warning siren affects nearby villagers like a bell, sending them to their homes.{0}
manual.siren.line4: Sirens can be placed against walls or on top of {0}posts{1}, and connected with {2}redstone wires{3}.{4}
manual.siren.line5: Using an Engineer's Screwdriver on a siren brings up the interface to configure its signal colour. Additionally, a warning siren can be set to produce one of three different sounds: siren, klaxon or buzzer.
